synthetic.identity_seed_rule: 20261128 + numeric avatar suffix; freeze morph, mesh, material, accessories and voice family hashes before fitting

conditions.balance_rule: Each six-avatar block contains all six skin materials, each hair class twice and glasses three times; mapping is frozen in the asset manifest

camera.axes: x right, y up, z into scene
camera.subject_pose_basis: face-to-camera ray, not rig joint Euler angles

lighting.interpretation: Blender scene controls, not measured physical lux

head.boundary_diagnostic_rule: All 24 avatars, distance 1.0, day, shoulder yaw 0; 288 additional rows, separate from primary

speaking.avatar_assignment: Within each split, number rows from zero in case order. Visible slot j uses role avatars[(row+j) mod role-size]; an offscreen source uses the next avatar after the visible slots. Distinct avatars within a scene; no split crossing.
speaking.mouth_control: Every even repeat has one silent visible distractor with a different, independently timed viseme sequence; odd repeats leave non-speakers idle. No random seed or text/voice family crosses splits.
speaking.canonical_media: lossless RGB video plus PCM; direct encoder output is retained original
speaking.slots: left-to-right in the image, with pose/layout/permutation frozen before prediction
speaking.source_roles: avatar identities, voice families, utterance families, animation/take variants and all crops inherit one split
speaking.source_audio: own TTS with exact voice/model terms and hashes; one source per primary episode
speaking.offscreen_controls: Visible non-speakers may move their mouths independently; silence or missing input is not no_visible gold
speaking.label_basis: known emitting avatar and visible identities, with source-sample/viseme/renderer timestamps; scripted rather than human mouth truth

ami.split_unit: connected components of participant identity plus recording session family; a/b/c/d and all cameras/channels/crops remain together
ami.split_rule: SHA256 UTF-8(rubric_id + newline + lexicographically smallest full participant-or-session ID in component), first 8 hex as u32 mod 10: 0..5 train, 6..7 tune, 8..9 test
ami.before_media_selection: freeze full component map and selected canonical rows before model outputs
ami.component_ids: Use canonical participant/<publisher-id> and session/<a-b-c-d-family> identifiers. Entire components touching ES2002 or IS1000 are diagnostic-only, excluded before hash partitioning.
ami.candidate_windows: 2.4-second windows at starts 3*k seconds, integer k>=1; exact original PTS/sample boundaries retained. Canonical key is meeting/camera/target-participant/start-us/end-us; select one camera observation per underlying episode.
ami.label_rule: Within the whole window, exactly one annotated lexical speaker covers >=1.0 seconds. A is that target. Q is another source, with no target vocal event during the window plus 0.5-second guards. Ambiguous or malformed annotations are retained as unavailable or diagnostics before predictions.
ami.selection: sort eligible source intervals by SHA256(rubric_id + newline + canonical source key); no overlapping windows; min 120 target-speaking and 120 other-speaking planned test cases; retain missing inputs
ami.audio: one predeclared room/mixed microphone shared by all targets; never use target headset as classifier input
ami.labels: annotation proxy unless independently verified audible/visible truth; single-face A/Q is not multi-face selection
ami.test_camera_geometry: unknown unless measured; no invented desk distances

pointing04.known_exposure: all 15 subjects previously evaluated; reused diagnostic, never new unseen holdout
pointing04.report: all 2790 planned images and per-subject/class results; frozen reference cone and exact prior crop protocol; do not mix with synthetic denominators

calibration.selection: 50 hashed input tensors per distance/light cell from rendered training sources; AMI additions remain train-only and separately enumerated

eyes.detection: one-to-one gold box match at IoU >=0.5; >=95% recall and precision; planned no-face specificity >=95%; CPU/NPU paired matching and flips reported
eyes.mesh: six pre-mapped anatomical anchors; all visible-anchor 2D errors <=0.05 gold face-box diagonal on >=95% planned faces; unknown/missing fails; all-478 CPU/NPU drift separate
eyes.blendshapes: paired coefficients in [0,1], max absolute drift <=0.05 on same inputs and missing/nonfinite count zero; downstream mouth/facing task bars still apply; coefficient parity is not emotion truth

eyes_negative_frames.rule: own empty-desk/object renders, same role-specific scene families; test specificity >=137/144

conversion.acceptance: every candidate meets its own labelled-set bar; gains/losses and CPU disagreements are explicit, no claim of exact parity when decisions change; randomized tensors are smoke controls only

report: first usable output including context fill
same-input CPU control and unrelated voice impact
